description: Poll one owned board or matching-job subscription. Locally Ed25519-sign LF-joined voidly-alerts-v1, POST, /v1/agent/alerts/poll, DID, Unix timestamp, nonce, and SHA-256 of exact raw_body UTF-8 bytes; pass DID, timestamp, nonce and signature with raw_body. Results contain resource identities. Advance after_seq to next_seq. Create, pause, delete and webhook setup use the direct API.
